title: 2020 Pan-STARRS object turns out to be a 1966 NASA booster
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2020 Pan-STARRS object turns out to be a 1966 NASA booster, about 2020 (1966 mission) at space, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In September of 2020, Pan-STARRS found another object that was similarly baffling.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in September 2020 Pan-STARRS, a telescope that scans the sky for moving objects, found another object in space that puzzled astronomers. According to his telling, it turned out to be an old rocket booster from a 1966 mission by NASA, the US space agency. He tells it as an example of how a baffling object can end up having a human origin.
